k.d: Open vessel made to hold cut or artificial flowers or to stand as an ornament; a tulip vase is a vase.
Rounded lidded jar made for display.
Large footed vessel made as an ornament, indoors or in the garden (a cremation urn is F4).
Bottle made to be displayed, not to hold a drink.
Flat-backed vase with a hanging fitting, made to hang on a wall.
Straight-sided glass jar with a lid, often footed, made to stand on display (a jar made to store food is B5).
Bowl made to be looked at or to hold small decorative items (a bowl made to hold food is B5).
Sealed liquid-filled globe holding a scene and loose particles that fall when shaken.
Carved, fretted or moulded panel made to hang on a wall as ornament.
A self-adhesive vinyl or film motif, pattern or lettering applied to a wall, window or furniture to decorate it (DPH; provisional until a shop page shows wall stickers sold as a type).
Replica sword, gun or other weapon made for display that cannot injure, decorative wushu implements included (K-86, K-87).
Bomb, grenade, mine or artillery piece made inert and kept for display (K-85).

b.w: Vases and ceramics are judged by material and craft first.
Creators lead only in the dealer market.

k.d: Mirror with a hanging fitting, made to hang on a wall.
Full-length mirror made to lean against a wall from the floor, with no hanging fitting.
Full-length mirror held in its own free-standing frame, often tilting.
Plain mirror on a stand made to sit on a table or dresser (a grooming mirror is H1).
Empty frame made to hold and display a picture or photograph.

b.m: fit to the space and placement
b.w: Mirrors are chosen for the place first.
Distortion is the first quality fault.
Backing keeps the silvering from failing.

k.d: Candle poured into and burned in its own jar or vessel.
Small candle in a shallow metal or plastic cup.
Short candle made to burn standing in a holder that contains the melted wax.
Long, slender candle made for a candlestick.
Thick free-standing candle that burns without a container.
Small, wide, flat candle made to float and burn on water in a bowl or vase.
Open holder made to hold a lit candle; holder form is an attribute (provisional: a holder form becomes a kind if fetched shops sell and compare it as its own category).
Holder with a socket or spike made to hold one or more taper or pillar candles upright on a stem or base.
Small open holder made to hold a tealight.
Tool with a small bell on a handle made to put out a candle flame.

b.w: The house and scent family (a filter, never a level).

k.d: Vessel of scented oil with reeds that draw it up and release it into a room.
Powered device made to release fragrance into a room (K-183, B4-O3).
Scented wax piece made to be melted in a warmer, not burned.
Burner or electric warmer made to melt wax melts or oil (K-183).
Aerosol or pump spray made to scent a room.
Mixture of dried scented plant material displayed to scent a room.
Essential or fragrance oil sold for a diffuser or burner (K-183; an oil sold to treat a condition is H2).
Small bag or pouch of scented material made to scent a drawer, wardrobe or room (an odour absorber is B6).
Incense formed on or as a stick, burned to scent a room.
Incense pressed into a cone.
Incense formed as a long-burning coil.
Holder or burner made to burn home-fragrance incense (a rite burner is F4).
Bound bundle of dried herbs burned to scent or cleanse a room, not made for a named rite (K-115).
Scented wood chips, resin or powder burned on charcoal or a heater to scent a room (rite incense is F4).

b.w: Home fragrance is chosen by scent and house.

k.d: Ornament made to hang on a tree or festive display, whatever its theme.
Ornament made to sit on the top of a tree.
Long strand of foliage, tinsel, beads or other decoration made to drape or hang.
String of pennant-shaped flags hung as a festive decoration.
Long strip or roll of paper hung or thrown as a party decoration.
Ring of foliage, flowers or other decoration made to hang on a door or wall as a seasonal or festive ornament (an Advent wreath made for worship is F4).
Large decorative sock made to hang at a fireplace or wall at Christmas and be filled with gifts.
Manufactured tree made to be decorated for Christmas (a real tree is C3, K-72).
Set of dolls made to be displayed on tiers for a festival, not made for worship.
Seasonal arrangement made to stand at an entrance for a festival (B4-O2, K-116).
Cloth or mat laid round the foot of a Christmas tree to decorate it and hide the stand.
Reusable display calendar of fabric, wood or card with numbered doors or pockets for the days before Christmas (one sold filled with confectionery is food; an Advent wreath is F4).
Paper tube pulled apart by two people with a snap, holding small gifts.
Hand-held device that bursts with a bang and throws out streamers.
Hand-held wire coated with a slow-burning pyrotechnic that throws sparks (B-19).
Pyrotechnic device made to give a display of light, colour or noise (B-19).
Small pieces of paper, foil or other material thrown or scattered as a party decoration.
Machine that makes fog or haze for a party or display effect (K-145).
Sphere covered in small mirrors, often turned by a motor, that scatters light as a party or display effect.

b.v: condition codes in the grading registry only
b.w: Collectible ornaments are chosen by series and era.

k.d: Manufactured imitation of a flower, single stem or arranged.
Manufactured imitation of a plant other than a flower, foliage and trees included (K-74).
Real plant or moss treated so that it keeps its look without growing or care (K-74).
Real flowers dried for display.
Statue made to stand outdoors as a garden ornament.
Figure of a gnome made as a garden ornament.
Reflective sphere on a stand made as a garden ornament.
Ornamental pedestal, plinth or column made to stand in a garden, alone or carrying an urn, statue or gazing ball.
Rotating ornament on a rod that turns to show the wind direction.
Set of hanging tubes, rods or bells that sound when moved by the wind.
Garden ornament of vanes, cups or spirals that turns in the wind, staked or hung.
Ornamental fountain or flowing-water feature for a garden (B4-O1; its pump is C2, K-175).
Flag of a country, made to fly or hang.
Flag of a state, province or territory.
Small flag made to hang from a garden stake or stand.
Tapering flag, usually triangular.
Windsock or streamer made as a garden, festive or decorative ornament (DPH rename; a windsock made to show wind direction or strength is C6).
Tall narrow flag carried on a curved pole with a ground spike or base, made to stand outside as a sign or decoration.
Decorative or seasonal flag made to fly from a pole bracket on a house (a polity's flag is B4.8.1.01 or B4.8.1.02).
Sign made to hang from a bracket, chain or cord.
Flat sign or plaque made to fix to or stand against a wall.
Neon or LED sign made to show a lit word or motif, a decorative light that spells a message included.

b.w: Flags are chosen by material grade.

k.d: String of small lights made mainly as decoration (K-181).
Lantern made to stand or hang as decoration, lit or unlit, stone garden lanterns included (K-116, K-180).
Battery or LED light made in the shape of a candle.
Lamp in which heated wax rises and falls in a liquid, made mainly as decoration.
Pole made to fly a flag (K-192).
Wire or clip hook made to hang a tree ornament.
